from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, Optional

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """One financial metric instance from a single document."""
    company: Literal["比亚迪股份有限公司"] = Field(description="The company name, derived from the task")
    report_date: str = Field(description="The reporting date (e.g., '2015年9月30日' or '2024年3月31日')")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The period name (e.g., '2015年第三季度' or '2024年第一季度')")
    total_liabilities_and_equity: Optional[float] = Field(description="Total liabilities and equity value for this period, in yuan")
    comparative_period_end_date: Optional[str] = Field(description="The previous period end date for comparison (e.g., '2014年末' or '2023年12月31日')")
    comparative_total: Optional[float] = Field(description="Total from the comparative period, in yuan")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the key figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
